text: Sex education that includes information about contraception makes teens more likely to be sexually active.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.source: KFF Health Misinformation Tracking Poll Pilot
room.questionWording: Sex education that includes information about contraception and birth control increases the likelihood that teens will be sexually active
room.note: 25% probably true, 37% probably false, 30% definitely false; the definitely-true share (7%) is the published remainder.

truthSource.label: CDC, What Works: Sexual Health Education
truthSource.oneLine: Reviews of school-based sexual health education find it does not hasten sexual initiation and is associated with delaying it.
